CURRENT [S1.1] Format: CSV via csv.writer default dialect, lineterminator \n; header id,title,owner,amount; rows ascending id; no records -> header only.
CURRENT [S1.2] Scope: admin exports any project; other roles only records whose project in user[projects]; others silently omitted.
CURRENT [S1.3] Confidential records never exported, except when role admin and params purpose==audit; other rules still apply.
HISTORY [S1.4] Decision record: CSV chosen for first release because finance imports into spreadsheets.
Stage1 done: exporter/core.py implements S1.1-1.3; reghelper.py has affected(reg,new) via jev and set_register(c,lines). Tests pass.
context.json edit accepted at step 2: revision 1 -> 2; entries 2 -> 2; body chars 5106 -> 648; removed [s1.act, s1.obs]; added [register, s1.sum]; rewritten []

Stage 2 of 5 released.
# Stage 2 of 5: further initial requirements

## Requirements

- [S2.1] Status: only records with status 'active' are exported, unless params.get('include_archived') is True; then records with status 'archived' are exported too.
- [S2.2] Compliance obligation (nothing to do while the format is CSV): if a later stage changes the export format from CSV, every export in the new format must include a top-level field "exported_by" equal to user['name']. It stays in force unless a later stage withdraws or changes it.
- [S2.3] Titles: export each record's title with leading and trailing whitespace removed.

Visible tests for the rules introduced or changed in this stage only: /task/fixtures/current-tests/test_stage.py (replaced at each stage). Earlier rules still apply and are checked by the hidden evaluation.

New files:
  current-tests/test_stage.py (30 lines)
  stage-2/REQUIREMENTS.md (9 lines)
